description: Source code for firmware upgrade management, including functions for retrieving firmware info, download status, initiating downloads, and handling firmware update processes with thread-based execution and system interactions.

methods.name: GetFirmwareName
methods.description: Reads the firmware name from /version.txt and extracts the imagename field.

methods.name: FwDlDmlDIGetDLFlag
methods.description: Checks /etc/device.properties for build type to determine if download is allowed.

methods.name: FwDlDmlDIGetFWVersion
methods.description: Retrieves current firmware version using GetFirmwareName.

methods.name: FwDlDmlDIGetDLStatus
methods.description: Gets current download status and maps it to a string.

methods.name: FwDlDmlDIGetProtocol
methods.description: Retrieves the download protocol from syscfg.

methods.name: FwDlDmlDISetProtocol
methods.description: Sets the download protocol in syscfg.

methods.name: FwDlDmlDIDownloadNow
methods.description: Initiates firmware download by setting URL and starting download thread.

methods.name: FwDlDmlDIDownloadAndFactoryReset
methods.description: Initiates firmware download with factory reset via thread.

methods.name: FwDmlDIGetURL
methods.description: Retrieves the download URL from syscfg.

methods.name: FwDmlDIGetImage
methods.description: Gets the firmware image to download, handling factory reset case.

methods.name: FwDlDmlDISetURL
methods.description: Sets the download URL in syscfg.

methods.name: FwDlDmlDISetImage
methods.description: Sets the firmware image to download in syscfg.

methods.name: FwDl_ThreadFunc
methods.description: Performs firmware download, updates LED states, and reboots device.

methods.name: FwDlAndFR_ThreadFunc
methods.description: Performs firmware download and factory reset, then reboots device.

methods.name: convert_to_validFW
methods.description: Sanitizes firmware filename to a valid format.
